body:
#### PR description:
- Updates and fixes in the trigger geometry
- Add trigger geometry for the V19 HGCAL geometry
- Refactoring of the tool used for testing the trigger geometry

#### PR validation:
- Basic checks: `runTheMatrix.py -w upgrade -l 37634.0 --maxSteps=2`
- Checked impact on the trigger primitives properties using the V19 geometry: shown [here](https://validation.llrhgcal.in2p3.fr/prod/list_config.php?pr=PR145)

#### Backport
This PR will need to be backported to `20_0_X`
title: [HGCAL trigger] Updates and fixes in the HGCAL trigger geometry
